findings.summary: Self-review caught the extracted render being stale at birth (build 2149's checkout predates EXPORT-010's registry entry); fixed by deterministic re-render via migration_registry.render_state using the same ledger snapshot against the current registry.

CI surfaced a second stale pin: the Workshop provenance-visibility regression asserts the production tip, W4-era. Claim extended via a proper extend-surfaces control PR; the pin moved with a dated rationale; the selector property restated tip-relative so it cannot silently go stale; the original W4->W3 guarantee preserved family-scoped.

PROCESS BREACH, recorded not hidden: the writer's own automation merged PR 827 while merge preflight was failing 'merge requires the package review receipt' -- a receipt-tail commit had silently failed (the file was absent after a branch rebuild) and the chain lacked an exit gate on merge-preflight failure, so the Azure merge proceeded on CI-green alone. The candidate bytes on main are exactly the reviewed bb0ebc51 content; what was bypassed was the receipt-before-merge ordering, not review substance. Remediated by this receipt-tail follow-up merged before close; root cause (missing exit gate) corrected in the writer's chain template.
